name: vinyl-image-generator
title_zh: 把记忆与情绪压成一张可触摸的虚构黑胶唱片
tagline_zh: 输入一句话、一段故事或一张旧照，输出四件套：封面、封底、A/B 面盘面，像独立厂牌刚寄来的样片。
tagline_en: Feed it a memory, line, or photo—get a 4-piece fictional vinyl: sleeve, back, Side A/B, like a real indie label.
desc_en: Transform a memory, sentence, emotion, story, object, place, or source image into one cohesive fictional vinyl release artifact containing a front sleeve, back sleeve, vinyl Side A, and vinyl Side B. Use when generating a believable 4:3 landscape product photograph of an independent-label record whose visual language, typography, printing history, packaging, and physical materials express the sour
why_zh: 不是贴图拼贴，而是把视觉语言、字体、印刷史、包装材质当成一个连贯的设计系统来推理，产物有物理可信度。
why_en: Not collage—it reasons across typography, print history, and materials as one coherent system, so the artifact feels physically.
limit_zh: 只产出 4:3 横版产品摄影图，不生成可播放音频；需要你提供足够具体的源素材（情绪/故事/物件）。
limit_en: Outputs only 4:3 landscape product shots, no playable audio; needs a concrete source (emotion/story/object) or covers become hollow decoration.
